pages.text: The Cell Workbench allows you to configure $(l:items_blocks_machines/storage_cells)storage cells$(/l) and $(l:items_blocks_machines/view_cell)View Cell$(/l)s.$(br2)You can add $(l:items_blocks_machines/upgrade_cards)upgrade cards$(/l) and configure "partitions" to filter what the cell will store.$(br2)Items and fluids can be dragged into the slots from JEI/REI even if you don't actually have any of that item.
Right-click with a fluid container (like a bucket or fluid tank) to set that fluid as a filter instead of the bucket or tank item.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: The cell workbench has a few buttons on the top-left:$(li)You can partition a cell based on its existing contents$(li)You can clear the cell's partitioning$(li)The workbench can be set to retain the partition settings when the cell is removed, allowing you to copy settings between cells.
